name: viche
description: Repo-root JS toolchain for the Viche frontend build (Tailwind CLI + the vendoring bundler). Not a published package.

comments.circomlibjs/snarkjs: Pinned exactly, without a caret, on purpose. These are not build helpers - their bytes are vendored verbatim into crates/viche-frontend/public/vendor/ and shipped to voters' browsers, where they handle the voter's secret in cleartext. crates/viche-frontend/tools/vendor.mjs re-asserts both versions and refuses to run against a different node_modules. See public/vendor/VENDOR.md.
comments.esbuild: Pinned exactly because it produces one of those shipped files (the circomlibjs Poseidon bundle); a different esbuild emits different bytes and `make frontend-vendor-check` would report drift.
comments.tailwindcss: Pinned exactly so the generated stylesheet is reproducible. Replaces the cdn.tailwindcss.com play CDN, which shipped a runtime JIT compiler incompatible with a strict CSP.
